scope_note: Ratified treaties only: records of type "treaty" in the OSU database whose Kappler header gives a Statutes at Large citation and no "unratified" marking (370 treaties, 1778-1868). Agreements, executive orders, unratified treaties and acts are not included in "treaties". California: the 18 treaties negotiated in 1851-52 (OSU records with 5-digit IDs, e.g. treaty-with-the-iou-ol-umnes-we-chillas-etc-1851-21826) were never ratified; the Senate rejected them in secret session in 1852. Alaska: no treaties with Native villages (Alaska Native claims were handled by statute, ANCSA 1971). No California rancheria or Alaska village is linked to any treaty.
links_note: basis values used: "successor named in official name" = the modern nation's official name carries the signatory people's name; "recognized successor (historic name differs from official name, or one of several successors)" = band-level or multi-successor relation drawn from the treaty text and the nation's name, from my own historical knowledge, not from a database tag. No link rests on a database tag because OSU removed them.
